edges.notes: Inline axios.get on the literal http://localhost:8080/admin/alumni (backend/server.js listens on PORT || 8080; backend/.env sets PORT = 8080). server.js mounts AdminRoutes at /admin; router.get('/alumni')
Inline axios.put(`http://localhost:8080/admin/alumni/${id}/verify`) on the literal local server (port 8080). AdminRoutes mounted at /admin; router.put('/alumni/:id/verify')

Inline axios.get(`http://localhost:8080/api/user/${userId}`) (userId from localStorage). userRoutes mounted at /api/user; router.get('/:id') (the earlier router.get('/') matches only the bare mount path)
Inline axios.put(`http://localhost:8080/api/user/${userId}`, formData). userRoutes mounted at /api/user; router.put('/:id')
fetchUsers(): fetch('http://localhost:8080/api/user') with no method (GET). userRoutes mounted at /api/user; router.get('/', protectRoute, getUsersForSidebar)
fetchMessages(): fetch(`http://localhost:8080/api/messages/${selectedUser._id}`) with no method (GET). messageRoutes mounted at /api/messages; router.get("/:id")
handleSendMessage(): fetch(`http://localhost:8080/api/messages/send/${selectedUser._id}`, { method: 'POST' }). messageRoutes mounted at /api/messages; router.post("/send/:id")
Inline axios.post("http://localhost:8080/api/events", eventData). eventRoutes mounted at /api/events; router.post("/")
Inline axios.post('http://localhost:8080/api/alumni/signup', formData) (multipart). AuthAlumniRouter mounted at /api/alumni; router.post('/signup')

fetch(url, { method: 'POST' }) where url = userType === 'alumni' ? 'http://localhost:8080/api/alumni/login' : 'http://localhost:8080/auth/login' (lines 35-37); this is the alumni alternative. AuthAlumniRouter mounted at /api/alumni; router.post('/login')
Same fetch(url, { method: 'POST' }); the student alternative 'http://localhost:8080/auth/login'. AuthRouter mounted at /auth; router.post('/login')
Inline axios.post('http://localhost:8080/auth/signup', formData) (multipart). AuthRouter mounted at /auth; router.post('/signup')
